item.title: Grays Ferry residents advised to stay indoors after trash fire creates air quality issues
item.description: A trash fire at the Philadelphia Transfer Station in Grays Ferry on Thursday night prompted city health officials to warn residents to stay indoors due to potential poor air quality. No hazardous substances were immediately identified by inspectors.

item.title: Local 98 continues the tradition of helping the Philadelphia Mummers Parade
item.description: For generations, IBEW Local 98 has been a proud part of one of Philadelphia’s greatest traditions — the Mummers Parade. Hundreds of our members actively participate in Mummers clubs, helping to make the parade what it is today, while thousands of Local 98 families support those clubs throughout the year. The 2026 parade was no different.

item.title: DoorDash, Uber Eats can deliver alcohol in 30 states, but not Pennsylvania. Lawmakers may change that
item.description: A proposed law that would allow DoorDash, Uber Eats and other third-party services to deliver alcohol in Pennsylvania is being considered by state lawmakers. Thirty states, including New Jersey, allow third-party delivery of beer, wine and cocktails.

item.title: Should the Eagles exercise their fifth-year options for Jalen Carter and Nolan Smith?
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles have decisions to make on two players eligible to have their fifth-year options picked up by the team. They are DT Jalen Carter and EDGE Nolan Smith, who were both selected in the first round of the 2023 draft.

item.title: Eagles chairmain Jeffrey Lurie, other NFL owners can't be publicly graded by NFL players anymore
item.description: The NFL won its grievance vs. the NFLPA, which can no longer publish team report cards. The Eagles ranked 22nd overall in the 2025 report cards.

item.title: Michael Rapaport says his brash personality on 'The Traitors' was part performance, part reality
item.description: Michael Rapaport, who recently appeared in Season 4 of 'The Traitors,' will headline three shows at Valley Forge Casino on Friday and Saturday. The actor initially aligned himself with Donna Kelce, and went viral for eating pasta.

item.title: Jill Scott pays homage to North Philly on new album 'To Whom This May Concern'
item.description: Jill Scott's first album in a decade includes a track honoring North Philly. 'Norf Side,' in collaboration with fellow Philadelphian Tierra Whack, includes multiple shoutouts to the neighborhood.

item.title: How Philadelphia became the sweet spot for America's iconic holiday candies
item.description: Philadelphia was once America's candy capital, home to chocolatiers who created Whitman's Sampler, Peanut Chews and bubble gum. Many beloved Valentine's Day treats and holiday candies have Pennsylvania roots.

item.title: Amid concern over ICE raids in region, Philly school district reaffirms policy to protect students
item.description: The School District of Philadelphia sent a letter to families Friday reaffirming its policy to protect student privacy and safety if ICE agents conduct operations near schools. The district said there have been no verified reports of ICE at school properties.

item.title: Sixers rookie VJ Edgecombe named 2026 NBA Rising Stars MVP after scoring both game-winners for Team Vince
item.description: VJ Edgecombe predictably brought his intensity and clutch nature to Los Angeles for All-Star weekend. He had two game-winning shots in as many contests.
